sede.contactMessage:
Hello, I am contacting you from {school} to request additional student capacity.

Our contract covers {contracted} students, with {allocated} places allocated to other campuses. We need capacity for {requested} students at {campus}, with {available} places currently available.

We would need a total capacity of {total} students, an increase of {increase} places. Please let us know how to update our plan and the additional cost. Thank you.
